title: Add semantic expansion service

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 semantic-expansion service capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current-head DecisionContextCompiler.expand_decision_context service with DecisionContextExpansionRequest@1. It resolves exactly one closure-admitted semantic node by content identity, admits only an expansion-tier handle named for the request question, checks exact parent request/context/witness/repository/tree/authority/semantic-root bindings, produces a compact retry delta, and fail-closes on changed inputs, repeated requests, malformed content, or budget exhaustion. No competing PCSM schema, source-map authority, resolver, model authority, or mutation path was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable service and its direct positive/negative tests are current-head and pass in the authoritative sealed environment, but no canonical PCSM aggregate SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID currently binds the named PCSM forest's concrete file/node/span identities. The service therefore cannot truthfully report a source-forest expansion instance, result CID, or promotion from this receipt-only task.

The exact PCSM SourceMap/SourceLink search produced no result, so a Git tree/blob or generic semantic-graph root is not substituted for a concrete PCSM source-map CID.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound outer commit/tree, admitted gitlink/head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source/test digest, contract version/schema, source-map capability, or validation result requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or canonical PCSM source-map CID resolves exact PCSM file/node/span identities in the named accelerator implementation/test roots. The service's repository/tree, semantic-graph-root, semantic-node content IDs, Git trees, Git blobs, and SHA-256 file digests are valuable freshness bindings but are not falsely relabelled as this missing source-map contract.

determinism_and_binding.identity: The request and budget inherit CanonicalContract: canonical JSON determines content_id/cid, caller-supplied content IDs are recomputed and rejected on mismatch, and the request has a separately deterministic equivalent_request_id over the completeness witness, normalized question, reference ID, and referenced content ID.
request_binding: expansion-tier ContextReference and referenced content ID
determinism_and_binding.admission: The compiler requires that the handle was admitted by the original closure/witness, that its repository/tree/semantic-root metadata exactly matches the parent bindings, and that its named unresolved question is one of the handle's admitted questions. It resolves bytes by exact SHA-256 content ID, decodes a canonical SemanticNode, and verifies its node/content identity against the admitted dependency before constructing an inline delta.
determinism_and_binding.budgeting: The service intersects request, parent, and compiler item/token/byte limits; preserves one cumulative budget identity per witness; rejects repeated equivalent requests, omitted lineage, incorrect index, count/token/artifact/wire-byte/latency budget breaches, and changed parent roots or authority.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: The accelerator compiler controls expansion admission and retry-delta construction only. ipfs_datasets retains canonical semantic identity; ipfs_kit retains exact-byte/CID storage; a PCSM local name does not become canonical identity. Model output is not a request, a semantic node, evidence, mutation authority, or promotion authority. This service neither performs M2/M3 mutation nor accepts a result as proof or completion authority.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The existing service already provides a versioned, CID-bound, deterministic semantic-node expansion path and fail-closed boundaries required for Python v1. Adding a PCSM wrapper/schema or a second resolver would duplicate authority and exceeds exact declared-output authority.

positive_coverage: A question-bound closure-admitted expansion yields only a compact delta, reconstructs the exact parent, preserves semantic-node identity, reduces replay tokens, and JSON-round-trips the expansion request.
Retry deltas preserve omissions and exact parent reconstruction, and repeated paired retries retain mandatory closure coverage while reducing token input.
negative_coverage: Repeated equivalent requests and unrelated questions fail closed.
Unadmitted/cross-boundary handles and repository/tree/semantic-root/authority drift fail closed.
Count, token, artifact-byte, and latency budget breaches fail closed.
Forged retry identities, unknown fields, corpus browsing, structural dependency change, cancellation, and stale root/authority states remain rejected or invalidated.

limitations: This exact-output dispatch is receipt-only. It does not modify the selected accelerator service/tests, create a parallel PCSM service, or materialize generated source.
The generic semantic-graph-root and repository/tree bindings are not substitutes for the unavailable canonical PCSM file/node/span source-map CID.
The ContentAddressedContextStore is an in-memory resolver in this implementation; storage durability remains an external authority concern and is not claimed here.

The service constrains one closure-admitted semantic-node expansion and a compact retry delta; it does not itself implement later PCSM-071 through PCSM-076 symbol/span/counterexample/test expansion, refinement, or fallback policies.
No model output, test result, or request is treated as evidence, proof, source mutation, M2/M3 mutation, promotion, or completion authority.
This receipt has no immutable self-CID because adding one would change its bytes.
